# Captain v2 Current Status

Last updated: 2026-04-01

## Purpose
This is the rolling handoff file for quick resume. Update this file after each meaningful firmware, wiring, or workflow change.

## Firmware Snapshot
- Project folder: Captain-v2
- Default environment: captain_matrix_c6_idf
- Upload method in active use: UART serial on COM8

## Matrix C6 Bring-Up (Current)
- Board target: ESP32-C6 matrix board via ESP-IDF env `captain_matrix_c6_idf`.
- Active serial path: external UART bridge on COM8.
- Native USB note: GPIO12/GPIO13 are used by matrix hardware, so native USB-Serial/JTAG is not considered reliable on this board revision.
- On-carrier boot status: restored and stable after removing the resistor path tying `Sw_Col_3` to GPIO9.
- Active firmware mode: matrix switch-scan scaffold (no local shift-register driving in this board variant).
- Current switch columns in scaffold: `Sw_Col0=GPIO20`, `Sw_Col1=GPIO19`, `Sw_Col2=GPIO18`, `Sw_Col3=GPIO23`.

## Known-Good Upload Command
```powershell
cd "C:\cfhe\Captain-v2"
C:\Users\user\.platformio\penv\Scripts\platformio.exe run -e captain_matrix_c6_idf -t upload
```

## Resume Checklist
- [ ] Confirm folder is Captain-v2
- [ ] Select env `captain_matrix_c6_idf`
- [ ] Confirm upload/monitor on COM8
- [ ] Ensure BOOT (GPIO9) is released for normal run (not ROM download)
- [ ] Verify `captain_idf` boot/alive log lines and switch mask updates
